name: unify-docs-template
description: The docs template for unify, the HTML-native static site generator: a documentation site in the fwdslsh family's look, with a sidebar, a catalog-driven directory of every page, and an importer that publishes a repository's docs/ folder. Scaffold it with: unify init unify-docs-template, or build on it with extends: unify-docs-template
author: Unify Contributors
